description: This file contains JavaScript code that configures and applies a visual skin/theme for the SmartClient UI framework, including setting styles, properties, and defaults for various UI components such as windows, buttons, grids, and controls.

classes.name: IButton
classes.description: A custom button class for consistent styling of buttons within the SmartClient skin.

classes.name: IAutoFitButton
classes.description: A subclass of IButton with auto-fitting properties for flexible button sizing.

classes.name: StretchImgSplitbar
classes.description: A class representing a stretchable split bar used for resizing components.

classes.name: ImgSplitbar
classes.description: A class for a resize bar with a grip, used for component resizing.

classes.description: A styled header for sections within the UI.

classes.name: Window

classes.name: Dialog
